title: Coast Guard rescues fisherman moments before boat sinks
description: Seen here is footage taken aboard a Coast Guard Air Clearwater MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter Thursday, March 23, 2017,  as the crew rescues a fisherman moments before his 12-foot dinghy sank less than a mile west of Fort De Soto, Florida. The initial mayday call from the fisherman can be heard as well.  (U.S. Coast Guard video)
